# OpenFile <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Files](BlitzBasic-Files)

</div>


```blitzbasic
OpenFile:Int32 filename:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `filename` | In | String | required | The file to open. |

**Returns:** A file handle, or 0 when the file does not exist.

## Description

Opens an existing file for reading and writing at once, keeping what is in it. Use [SeekFile](SeekFile) to move around before you read or write.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
file = WriteFile("files_open_example.tmp")
WriteByte file, 1
WriteByte file, 2
CloseFile file
file = OpenFile("files_open_example.tmp")
SeekFile file, 1
WriteByte file, 9
SeekFile file, 0
Print ReadByte(file)
Print ReadByte(file)
CloseFile file
DeleteFile "files_open_example.tmp"
```

```text
1
9
```
